messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Draft Contract and TR1 issued via the data room. As noted it's on SCPC 3rd edition, TOGC basis, 10% deposit as stakeholder. We'd expect a light touch — let us have your comments and we'll aim to exchange w/c 23 February.

Marcus

messages.subject: RE: Project Harbor — draft Contract (our comments)
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus,

Thank you. Our comments are light. We're content with the structure. Two points we'd like: (i) tighten the arrears recovery clause (6.2) so we're not obliged to litigate at our own cost; and (ii) keep completion at 2.00pm. We'll send a redline today.

James
